name: Massachusetts
dueDateNotes: Massachusetts follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Massachusetts applies its flat 5.0% rate to your income after a personal exemption ($4,400 single / $8,800 joint) — it grants that exemption instead of a standard deduction. Income over $1,083,150 is taxed at 9% (the 4% surtax). The surtax threshold shown is the 2025-basis amount and adjusts yearly.
uniqueFacts: Massachusetts taxes most income at a flat 5.0% rate, effective January 1, 2026.
Massachusetts adds a 4% 'millionaire' surtax on taxable income over $1,083,150, bringing the top rate to 9% on income above that line.
Massachusetts gives personal exemptions ($4,400 single / $8,800 joint) in place of a standard deduction.
